description: This file defines a React component named 'ChartBox' that renders different types of charts (bar, pie, line) using the Chart.js library via react-chartjs-2. It imports necessary chart.js modules and registers them, and uses props to determine which chart to display along with its title and data.

methods.name: ChartBox({ type, title, data, options })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a chart based on the 'type' prop ('bar', 'pie', or 'line') using react-chartjs-2 components, with a title and data passed via props.
